reason: Of the 16 audit checks that render AuditCheckConfiguration, only DeviceCertificateExpiringCheck has a Configuration in CloudFormation. That check renders DeviceCertExpirationAuditCheckConfiguration, so it accepts the Configuration, and the other 15 checks keep AuditCheckConfiguration.

The aws-batch L2 sets the fields of both CloudFormation types on the one shared ContainerProperties, at ContainerProperties and at NodeProperties.NodeRangeProperties.Container, so the shared type keeps all its fields.
